row.title: YEARFAIL-1: protected paths cannot ride a model branch
row.body: worker-gate refuses edits to .github/workflows and .github/dependabot.yml from claude/* branches, so the weekly yearfail workflow and the full Dependabot config are staged as data in doctrine/protected/ with items Q-YEARFAIL-workflow and Q-DEPROT-dependabot; the dependency detector holds a shrink-only baseline until they land. Never route around the gate by renaming the branch.

title: YEARFAIL-1: protected paths cannot ride a model branch
